page.overview:
Who is Matthew Mercer?

Matthew Mercer is a human bard from and . He is based on the real Matthew Mercer. In his first appearance, he is an NPC played by the Dungeon Master, Liam O'Brien. In his second appearance, he is a player character played by Matthew Mercer.

Matthew Mercer the character is a heavy-metal, motorcycle-riding version of Matthew Mercer the actor.

He is a nerdy DnD player who loves Marisha. He looks exactly like Matthew Mercer the actor as a teenager.

Matt Mercer shares a near identical background with the voice actor Matt Mercer. However, he also survived the apocalypse and survived alongside Marisha Ray. At some point Matt took to wearing an eyepatch.
